title: Microsoft Windows Error Reporting Manager Improper Access Control Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to escalate privileges on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Windows. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute medium-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Windows Error Reporting Manager (wermgr). The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to delete any files accessible to SYSTEM.
